_readme: The entries below target the fictional fixture PDF (scripts/make_test_pdf.py), so the
harness is runnable out of the box. REPLACE THEM with 20-30 questions about your own
documents in data/ - that is what actually measures this system.
expected_source - the filename in data/ the answer should come from
expected_pages  - page number(s) that should be retrieved; hit-rate@k checks these
reference_answer- optional, only used by the LLM-as-judge correctness score
Retrieval hit-rate needs no API key and no judge: it just asks whether the right page
made it into the retrieved set. That single number is what tells you whether a change
to chunking, the embedding model, BM25 or the re-ranker actually helped.

questions.question: How much funding did Project Nightingale receive?
questions.reference_answer: A grant of 1.2 million dollars from the Global Wildlife Fund, covering 2021 to 2024.

questions.question: Which two previously undocumented stopover sites were identified?
questions.reference_answer: One in the Yellow River Delta and one near Poyang Lake.

questions.question: How many satellite tags were deployed and where?
questions.reference_answer: 42 tags across three breeding grounds in northern Russia.

questions.question: What percentage of the budget goes to field operations?
questions.reference_answer: 30 percent, with a recommendation to increase it by 10 percent in the final year.

questions.question: How long do tagged cranes rest at the Yellow River Delta site?
questions.reference_answer: An average of 11 days before continuing their migration.

questions.question: What is the battery life of each satellite tag?
questions.reference_answer: Approximately 18 months, transmitting location data every six hours.

questions.question: Who leads the project and at which institute?
questions.reference_answer: Dr. Amara Chen at the Boreal Ecology Institute.

questions.question: What does the team hypothesize about cranes departing later in the season?
questions.reference_answer: They take a more westerly route, hypothesized to be linked to wind patterns rather than food availability.

unanswerable.question: What is the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow?
unanswerable.note: Not in any ingested document - the system should decline rather than invent an answer. Measured as the 'refusal' metric.

unanswerable.question: How do I configure a Kubernetes ingress controller?
unanswerable.note: Also absent - checks the relevance floor is doing its job.
